title: Reliability coordinator space weather message
description: A reliability coordinator's dissemination of forecast and current space weather information to the entities in its geomagnetic disturbance operating plan: the source product, current and forecast conditions in plain words, any requested actions, and a distribution table with the method, send time and acknowledgement time for each entity. The distribution table is the evidence that each entity in the plan received the information.

source.description: The source product with code, serial number and issue time.
examples: SWPC WARK07, serial 214, issued 2026 Nov 06 1851 UTC

summary.description: Current and forecast conditions in plain words, with the level and the time window.
examples: A K-index of 7 (G3, Strong) is expected from about 2100 UTC. Arrival time of the disturbance is uncertain by several hours.

requestedActions.description: Actions requested of entities, per the operating plan.

examples: Confirm receipt and report any procedure actions taken.
Exercise message. All entities are fictional.
